baseline_tests.meaning: Existing behavior regression only; not proof of a fix

proposed_fix.approval: required before product edits under harness-rules.md hotfix rule 9
proposed_fix.presentation: One Codex section, defaulting to the most recently reported account; other account snapshots remain explicitly accessible but collapsed by default.
proposed_fix.freshness: Label data as reported snapshots, not current login state. Expose window capture timestamps; mark outdated or already-reset values as pending refresh rather than current remaining capacity. Proposed freshness budget: 15 minutes, subject to confirmation.
preserve: Visibility of genuine multiple accounts through explicit expansion or selection
Existing quota collection protocol and agent feature version
regression_cases: One account, multiple accounts, and legacy API response
A historical account and a recently updated account produce one default quota section
Recently reported does not imply currently logged-in or still configured
All accounts stale, reset time elapsed, and fresh plan row with stale quota window
Account switching does not combine windows from different accounts
Chinese and English labels and responsive layout
